title: populus nigra italica
intro: Populus nigra italica, commonly known as Italian Black Poplar, is a deciduous tree species native to the Mediterranean region, characterized by its dark bark and broad, heart-shaped leaves. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Populus nigra italica include its ability to calm the nervous system, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential medicinal applications.
